_: How the farm's beasts idle (animals.gd reads it through data.gd; docs/TUNING.md). kinds.<kind>.life: the moves a beast of that kind plays one after another, each [move, how often it's picked, [fewest, most] times in a row]; a move is the model's own clip of that name, or one made in derive. derive.<move>: a head-down move made from the idle: from (the base clip), bones (the neck chain and the head, turned evenly), head (the head bone), muzzle (how far past the head bone the nose lies, in neck lengths: the rigs have no nose bone), to (the share of its standing height the muzzle comes down to: 0.1 is nose in the grass), bob ([degrees, seconds]: a slow chew, a pig's rooting, a quick peck), ease (seconds in and out). blend: seconds one move takes to become the next. horse_coats: the horses' coats (horse.gd): the first the bay as painted, the rest (chestnut, black, grey, dun) dyed onto the bay's undyed coat lifted to a mean brightness of horse_coat_weave (multiplied onto the bay past 1.0 they blew out to white blotches). change: how often the next move is another than the one just played (else any, by weight). busyRetry: seconds a beast doing something else (a horse walked, led or ridden) waits before its idle life tries again. mostTurn: the most a neck and head are turned in all, degrees (a short-necked rig stops here with its nose as low as it goes: the cow, sheep and war horse don't reach the grass by the neck alone). A kind the catalogue doesn't hold names its model and length (metres) here (the town dog: the Quaternius wolf shrunk to a hound). Goat and chicken have no model in the game yet: their lives wait here for one (its bone names may need setting).

set._: The farm's beasts drawn from one painted set (Mac 2026-11-12: one Meshy look across people, animals and props; docs/art/animals/STYLE.md, realm/tools/beast_rig.py): kinds, every one under dir; walks, the kinds that are driven or led and must step (hens keep to their yards) (animals.gd make/walk play Walk). tools/animals_check.gd fails a kind outside the set or without a walk; next: the kinds still on their kit models, listed until they join (square first: the hen and the dog, judged before the rest).
